claims.explanation: BMS-345541 selectively inhibits the catalytic IKK subunits CHUK/IKBKB, blocking NF-kB-dependent survival signaling; cancer lines with constitutive or inducible NF-kB activity (e.g., via NFKBIA/NFKB1/NFKB2 alterations, high TNF/IL1 pathway or RELA/RELB expression) should be most sensitive, while lines with low NF-kB dependence or compensatory survival signaling are protected. The transcriptional similarity to CDK inhibitors and downregulation of cell-cycle genes (TOP2A, CDC25B, TP53) suggests that sensitive lines also depend on NF-kB-driven proliferation and anti-apoptotic gene expression.
